{{Top|leg}}
A '''multisensor airflow analyzer''' was a device that measured the airflow around a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. Only able to be used in an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], the analyzer could detect [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacons]] or explosives attached to the exterior of the ship.
